item.description:
【the-decoder.com】The Lean and Mathlib community has officially confirmed Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis as correct. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. item.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
item.description:
【machinelearning.apple.com】We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution.
